title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
prompt: Suppose an array of length n sorted in ascending order is rotated between 1 and n times. Given the sorted rotated array nums of unique elements, return the minimum element of this array.
hints: Binary search. Compare nums[mid] with nums[right]. If nums[mid] < nums[right], min is in left half (including mid).
If nums[mid] > nums[right], the rotation point is in the right half - min is in (mid, right].
Update: right = mid when nums[mid] < nums[right], else left = mid + 1.
